integrity_notes: Theorem has an analytic subtree induction and a sharp four-voter construction. Integer verification is reproducible from the accompanying standalone Python file. Priority is conditional on inspected literature and may be revised by future independent source checking.
scientific_limitations: Each undirected support component is a tree with exactly one committed casting voter and no abstainers.
Each noncasting voter chooses one shared dated approval action. This is a synchronized-action specialization, not every possible interpretation of temporal confluence.
Date-dependent trust horizons are bounded by the date of the delegator action. Casting voters may be cited at different times within their persistent commitment interval.
No claim for cycles, multiple casters within one component, stochastic electoral behavior or other utilities.
Finite tests corroborate but do not replace the proof. No independent validation has been performed.
title: Synchronized temporal proxy voting on rooted forests: a polynomial welfare rule and a sharp four-voter obstruction
